title: CRTP Mixin Toolkit
hints: The base class never needs a virtual function: `Derived` is a template parameter, so `static_cast<const Derived&>(*this)` gives the full object at compile time (lesson 11.05).
In `Counted<Derived>`, a `static inline int s_alive{ 0 };` is a different variable for each `Derived`, because `Counted<Version>` and `Counted<Point>` are different classes.
requirements: `Comparable<Derived>` that gives `==`, `!=`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=` from one `compare` function in the derived class
`Printable<Derived>` that gives `operator<<` from a `print(std::ostream&)` in the derived class
`Counted<Derived>` that counts how many objects of each type are alive
One class that uses all three, and a second class to show the counts are kept per type
